code_review.project_type: web application — Dash SPA implementing an AI-assisted, multi-agent software-planning pipeline

existing_self_description.text: Spec4 is a Dash app (using Dash Mantine Components) that guides you from idea to deployment using a pipeline of specialised LLM agents. Start with a rough idea and finish with a set of structured, ordered development phases — plus an optional UI mock and deployment plan — ready to hand to an AI coding agent like Claude Code.

architecture.summary: A Dash Mantine Components UI (layouts + callbacks) drives a session/project-manager layer that sequentially invokes specialized LLM agents through a shared litellm gateway; one stage (AI-opportunity discovery) is itself a multi-stage sub-pipeline grounded by a markdown tier/mechanism pattern library.

commands.lint: uv run ruff check src/ tests/

directory_map.role: Agent modules for six of the seven pipeline agents (CodeScanner, Brainstormer, Designer, StackAdvisor, Phaser, Deployer) plus shared helpers; feature_speccer.py is Brainstormer's spec-drafting step, not an agent. Agentifier, the seventh agent, lives in src/spec4/agentifier/

Package root: app.py (Dash app, AppShell, two browser dcc.Stores), session.py (session defaults and artifact persistence), project_manager.py (artifact dependency graph, staleness detection, agent button state, usage.json rollups), llm_selection.py (per-agent model resolution shared by gate card, chip, and retry panel), usage_report.py (spec4-usage CLI)
AI-opportunity discovery sub-pipeline (Scout, Linker, Composer, Tier Analyst, Spec Drafter, Prioritizer, Cross-Cutting Analyst, Reference Verifier)
Markdown tier/mechanism catalog grounding Agentifier's recommendations
Static JS/CSS/image assets for the Dash frontend
Offline evaluation harnesses per agent (agentifier, deployer, designer, phaser, scout, stack_advisor, tier_calibration)
Scratch notes (prompts.txt) — not part of shipped source

env_vars.name: DASH_DEBUG
env_vars.purpose: Enables Dash hot-reload/debug mode in dev

env_vars.name: LITELLM_LOG
env_vars.purpose: Suppresses litellm's startup log verbosity; must be set before litellm is first imported

ai_capabilities.name: litellm
ai_capabilities.description: Multi-provider LLM gateway used by every pipeline agent (Brainstormer, Agentifier's Scout/Linker/Composer/Tier Analyst/Spec Drafter, StackAdvisor, Phaser, Designer, Deployer) to call configured LLM providers

ai_capabilities.name: Agentifier multi-agent pipeline
ai_capabilities.description: Custom multi-stage LLM pipeline (Scout → Linker → Composer → panel closure → Tier Analyst → Spec Drafter → infra expansion → Prioritizer → Cross-Cutting Analyst → Reference Verifier) that discovers and tiers AI-opportunity features from a codebase review

ui_summary.styling: Mantine component primitives + custom CSS (src/spec4/assets/v3.css); Inter and JetBrains Mono loaded from Google Fonts in app.py
ui_summary.routing: Dash callback-driven view switching via dcc.Location/browser history

conventions.value: Design decisions are recorded as numbered comments (D-XX, e.g. D-PH9, D-SC-P1) at the point of implementation; layout helpers in layouts/_shared.py (_card, cost_summary_card) are reused rather than duplicated; agent order is defined once in app_constants.AGENT_KEYS and tests assert other tables (e.g. layouts._AGENT_ROWS) against it

test_coverage.coverage_summary: pytest suite under tests/ mirrors the src/ layout: per-agent tests (test_agents.py), layout/callback contracts (test_callback_co_presence.py, test_cost_summary.py, test_agent_llm_selection.py), session and project-manager tests, plus tests/agentifier/ and tests/integration/. pytest-cov is a dev dependency and a .coverage artifact exists at repo root.

incomplete_or_dead_code: pyproject.toml's [[tool.mypy.overrides]] list includes module a2a_sdk/a2a_sdk.* but a2a_sdk is not declared in [project] dependencies — dead configuration until the dependency is added or the override removed.
No documented mypy invocation (Makefile target or README/CONTRIBUTING mention) exists despite strict = true being configured in pyproject.toml, so commands.typecheck could not be populated.

change_risks.risk: LITELLM_LOG/litellm.suppress_debug_info must be set before litellm is first imported by any downstream module; ruff's per-file-ignore comment documents that subsequent `import spec4.callbacks` statements are deliberately placed after this setup (noqa: E402)
change_risks.mitigation_hint: preserve the current import order in app.py; do not move litellm-dependent imports above the LITELLM_LOG/suppress_debug_info setup lines

change_risks.risk: Every Input of a registered callback must exist in the rendered layout when the callback fires; a layout change that removes or renames a component id breaks callbacks that reference it. tests/test_callback_co_presence.py enumerates each screen's expected ids
change_risks.mitigation_hint: keep every existing component id; add new components with new ids; keep the agent pill bar and the chat action row as separate subtrees so their callbacks' Inputs stay co-present

change_risks.risk: tests/test_cost_summary.py and tests/test_agent_llm_selection.py assert relative ordering of components (cost card between transcript and token count; model chip before status line)
change_risks.mitigation_hint: preserve these orderings when re-framing the chat layout; run uv run pytest after every layout change

change_risks.risk: All state lives in two browser dcc.Stores (session in sessionStorage, prefs in localStorage); there is no server-side session. Reading working_dir, llm_config, or agent state on the server side of a callback requires threading the store through as a State
change_risks.mitigation_hint: new status-bar and project-view components read from the existing stores via callback State, not from module globals

change_risks.risk: usage.json is deliberately excluded from the artifact dependency graph; including it would mark downstream agents Needs Update after every run
change_risks.mitigation_hint: derive tree status from detect_stale_inputs / agent_button_state as-is; render usage.json's status from file presence only

other_notes: Secondary CLI script declared in pyproject.toml: spec4-usage = spec4.usage_report:main (usage reporting), distinct from the primary spec4 entrypoint.
py.typed marker present at src/spec4/py.typed — package declares itself fully typed.

Project planning artifacts appear to be persisted as local JSON files under a per-project .spec4/ directory (e.g. .spec4/v0/ai_features.json, per evals/agentifier/run_mechanism_probe.py's docstring), rather than a conventional database — no DB driver, ORM, or connection string found in dependencies or source samples.
No containerization, orchestration, PaaS, or IaC files appear in the provided file tree; production launch today is via the Makefile's serve target (gunicorn) with no deployment platform wiring yet.
mystuff/prompts.txt looks like scratch/dev notes rather than shipped source.

evals/ is a substantial offline evaluation harness (mechanism scoring, deployment-signal coverage, dependency-ordering checks, scout calibration fixtures, tier-calibration fixtures) measuring each pipeline agent's output quality against gold/expectation fixtures — effectively Spec4's own internal QA suite for its LLM agents, separate from pytest.
